overall_goal: Bake the tarts in the oven and let them cool

goals.description: Place the muffin trays in the oven and set the timer
goals.rationale: The person opens the oven, places both muffin trays inside, closes the door, and sets the timer to bake the tarts.

goals.description: Remove the baked tarts from the oven and set them on the hob to cool
goals.rationale: The person takes both muffin trays out of the oven, closes the door, and arranges them on the hob to cool.
